nodes.description: Mapping of reflection balances credited to each address; core accounting of the reflection token.
Mapping kept in storage but unused across the implementation; declared token balance ledger.
ERC20 nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount, written by _approve and read by transferFrom.
Flags addresses excluded from fee/cooldown logic; set for owner, contract and fee wallets.
Blacklist mapping managed by nonosquare/delBot; gates transfers inside _transfer.
Per-address cooldown timestamp mapping used together with block.timestamp to throttle buys.
Total reflection supply; decremented in _reflectFee.
Accumulated token fee counter incremented in _reflectFee.
Fee/treasury wallet address which is also the privileged caller for manualswap and manualsend.
Uniswap V2 router address set in openTrading and used for swaps and liquidity.
Token/ETH pair address created in openTrading; used as transfer direction discriminator.
Reentrancy guard flag set by the lockTheSwap modifier around swapTokensForEth.
Toggles automatic swap-and-send fee conversion inside _transfer.
Toggles the cooldown restriction; settable by the owner via setCooldownEnabled.
Maximum transaction amount enforced on pair buys when cooldown is enabled.
Contract owner address used by the onlyOwner modifier and by the owner() accessor.
One-shot flag preventing repeated calls to openTrading.
Untrusted caller address propagated through _msgSender into transfers, approvals and privileged checks.
Miner-controllable timestamp used for cooldown bookkeeping and as Uniswap deadlines.
Private core transfer routine applying fee logic, blacklist, cooldown and the automatic swap-to-ETH/send cycle before calling _tokenTransfer.
Private lockTheSwap function approving and swapping contract tokens for ETH through the Uniswap router.
Private function forwarding accumulated ETH to _feeAddrWallet2 via transfer.
Owner-only one-shot initializer creating the Uniswap pair, adding liquidity and enabling swap/cooldown.
Owner-only function batch-blacklisting addresses in the bots mapping.
Owner-only function removing a single address from the bots blacklist.
Privileged externally callable function that swaps the entire contract token balance for ETH when called by _feeAddrWallet1.
Privileged externally callable function that forwards the whole contract ETH balance to the fee wallet when called by _feeAddrWallet1.
Private indirection to _transferStandard that performs the reflection bookkeeping and emits Transfer.
Public ERC20 entrypoint calling _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
Public ERC20 entrypoint that transfers on behalf of a sender and reduces the allowance.
Public ERC20 entrypoint delegating to _approve for the caller.
Modifier function enforcing _owner == _msgSender() for privileged entrypoints.
External call to uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with attacker-influenceable token amount and block.timestamp deadline.
ETH value transfer to _feeAddrWallet2 using address.transfer, an external value-moving operation.
Equality check of _msgSender() against the hardcoded _feeAddrWallet1 used as the sole authorization for manualswap/manualsend.
External payable call to uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH using the contract ETH balance and block.timestamp deadline.
Sender address parameter of _transfer, used for zero-address, blacklist, pair and fee-exclusion checks.
Recipient address parameter of _transfer, used for zero-address, blacklist and cooldown checks.
Transfer amount parameter of _transfer constrained by _maxTxAmount and required to be non-zero.
Amount of tokens to swap passed into swapTokensForEth and forwarded to the router.
ETH amount parameter of sendETHToFee forwarded to _feeAddrWallet2.
Array of addresses batch-blacklisted by nonosquare.
Address removed from the blacklist by delBot.
Local snapshot of the contract token balance used to trigger the automatic swap.
Local snapshot of the contract ETH balance forwarded to the fee wallet.

edges.reason: transfer() forwards msg.sender as the from argument into the core _transfer routine.
from parameter directly drives address checks and fee/cooldown branches inside _transfer.
to parameter directly drives address checks, blacklist and cooldown branches inside _transfer.
amount parameter is compared against _maxTxAmount and propagated into the token transfer math.
block.timestamp controls the cooldown require and the cooldown[to] assignment, making the branch timestamp dependent.
cooldown mapping is read and written in _transfer using block.timestamp, an attacker-influenced value.
bots blacklist mapping gates the execution of the transfer branch in _transfer.
_owner (via owner()) determines whether fee, cooldown and swap logic are skipped in _transfer.
contractTokenBalance local is computed inside _transfer from balanceOf(address(this)).
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth before its own state effects are completed, enabling reentrant entry through the swap route.
contractTokenBalance local is passed as the swap amount into swapTokensForEth.
_transfer invokes sendETHToFee, an external value transfer executed while transfer accounting is still in flight.
swapTokensForEth performs the external Uniswap router swap operation.
uniswapV2Router state variable is read to build the WETH path and to issue the swap approval/call.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, making execution dependent on miner-controllable time.
sendETHToFee executes the ETH value transfer operation to the fee wallet.
_feeAddrWallet1/_feeAddrWallet2 recipient address is read when sending ETH to the fee.
The ETH forwarded by sendETHToFee is credited to the fee wallet address.
msg.sender is compared against _owner inside the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner gates execution of openTrading.
onlyOwner gates execution of nonosquare.
onlyOwner gates execution of delBot.
openTrading performs the external payable addLiquidityETH call on the router.
uniswapV2Router is assigned and then read to create the pair and add liquidity.
uniswapV2Pair state variable is written with the created pair address in openTrading.
openTrading writes the freshly deployed router instance into the uniswapV2Router state variable.
openTrading enables swapEnabled, unlocking the automatic swap branch inside _transfer.
openTrading enables cooldownEnabled, selecting the timestamp-dependent cooldown branch.
openTrading reduces _maxTxAmount, tightening the transfer amount constraint.
openTrading sets tradingOpen, controlling the one-shot require guard.
openTrading uses block.timestamp as the addLiquidityETH deadline, making it timestamp dependent.
manualswap authorizes callers by comparing msg.sender with _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorizes callers by comparing msg.sender with _feeAddrWallet1.
The privileged-address equality check is the only guard protecting manualswap.
manualswap triggers the swapTokensForEth external interaction path.
manualsend delegates the contract ETH balance to sendETHToFee.
bots_ parameter addresses are written into the bots blacklist mapping.
notbot parameter address is cleared in the bots blacklist mapping.
_transfer finalizes accounting by calling _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer reads and mutates the _rOwned reflection balances through _transferStandard.
_transfer reads _rOwned balances implicitly via balanceOf(address(this)) for the auto-swap trigger.
_rTotal feeds the reflection rate used to derive balances consulted by _transfer.
contractETHBalance local snapshot is forwarded as the amount argument to sendETHToFee.
The Uniswap router swap sends ETH back through receive()/fallback, allowing re-entry into the transfer path before state finalization.
ETH transfer to the fee wallet may invoke recipient fallback code that re-enters _transfer.
addLiquidityETH interacts with external pair contracts that can call back during liquidity provisioning.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter has no independent identity outside _transfer and should be folded into the core transfer routine node.
The to parameter is only meaningful as part of the _transfer logic and merges into that function node.
The amount parameter exists solely to constrain and drive _transfer and is merged into it.
tokenAmount is consumed only by the swap routine, so it merges into the swapTokensForEth core node.
The ETH amount parameter belongs exclusively to sendETHToFee and merges into that function node.
The bots_ array parameter is used only inside nonosquare and merges into it.
The notbot address parameter is local to delBot and merges into that function node.
This local mirrors the amount passed to the swap and belongs with the related unsafe swap operation.
This local carries the ETH amount into the fee transfer and merges into the related function node.
